program_name: Jupiter Spend referral program (personal; Jupiter Global Ambassador codes mentioned, programme not described)
application_conditions: Every Jupiter Spend user has a referral code/link; no application. 'Jupiter Global Ambassador' codes exist (campaigns page: ambassadors' referees get FX fees rebated for 30 days up to US$100) but no page read says who can become an ambassador, how to apply or what ambassadors earn. No publisher/affiliate/partner programme found on docs.jup.ag or the support centre (search 2026-11-11).
paid_action: Referee completes KYC and spends at least $50 on their Jupiter Card within 30 days of KYC approval → referrer receives $10 (credited to the Rewards balance held in USDC).
validation_conditions: 'If your friend does not spend $50 within 30 days of KYC approval, the referral expires and you do not receive a reward.' Self-referrals and duplicate accounts are blocked and forfeited. Referee separately earns $20 after spending $1,000 within 30 days of card activation. 'There is no cap on the number of referrals.'

commission.model_note: Flat $10 per qualifying referral (not a share of fees or spend). Referring at least 2 qualifying people in a calendar month also raises the referrer's own cashback to 4% (cap $200) the following month.

payout.method: Credited to the in-app Rewards balance (USDC); movable to the card balance instantly, not withdrawable to an external wallet
payout.holdbacks_note: Jupiter 'reserve[s] the right to update, amend, suspend, or discontinue any aspect of the Rewards and referral programs'.

rules_note: Personal programme designed for app users, not publishers: the code is entered at Global ID creation. Terms 'effective March 26, 2026'. Nobody contacted, no account opened.
allowed_countries_note: Follows Jupiter Card eligibility (about 50 countries + 34 US states; not EEA/UK).

evidence.title: Jupiter docs — Rewards & Referrals (terms effective March 26, 2026)
evidence.excerpt: 'Once your friend spends at least $50 on their Jupiter Card within 30 days of KYC approval, you receive $10.' 'Once your friend spends $1,000 within 30 days of card activation, they receive $20.' 'There is no cap on the number of referrals.' 'A referral code, including a Jupiter Global Ambassador's code, is entered in the Jupiter app when you create your Global ID.'

evidence.title: Jupiter docs — Spend campaigns
evidence.excerpt: 'Jupiter Global Ambassadors can offer this to the people they refer' — 0% FX fees for 30 days up to US$100 for new users entering an ambassador's code. Ambassador programme conditions not described.

notes: Identified only. A publisher programme, if any, would have to be asked of Jupiter directly — not without David's instruction.
